summary: Global Interactive Technologies, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a securities purchase agreement with FirstFire Global Opportunities Fund, LLC for a private placement of a $550,000 convertible promissory note (net proceeds $506,000 after $44,000 OID). The note bears 9% interest, matures in 12 months, and is convertible at 85% of VWAP (15% discount) upon default. Unregistered sales relied on Section 4(a)(2)/Rule 506. This is a routine financing, not a special situation.
